summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 (read-only audit complete — no files touched)  ### What I found I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` → SQLite. Every layer is already correctly scoped:  - **Client**: no localStorage/sessionStorage is used for watchlist data — it's plain React state re-fetched from `GET /watchlist` on mount. `api.ts` sends `credentials: "include"` on every call, so the session cookie is always attached. No guest/anonymous fallback exists anywhere in the client. - **Server**: `modules/watchlist/hand
